A DIFFERENT KIND OF CAMPUS TEST

How well do you
know Rutgers?

  1. Look closely.You get a real photo from somewhere around Rutgers–New Brunswick. Zoom in and drag the photo to inspect it.
  2. Find your spot.Pan and zoom the map, then click to place a pin. You can move it until you lock in.
  3. Make the call.There is no time limit. Get within 20 meters of the camera position for a perfect 5,000. Points depend only on distance.

Five rounds, each harder than the last: recognizable surroundings first, obscure angles and details later. No repeated locations in a game. No hints. Take as long as you like: only “Lock in your guess” submits a round.

Keyboard: focus the map, use arrows to pan and + / − to zoom. Use “Place pin at center,” then lock in your guess.
